page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-14-standardlssd is a memory-optimized server instance from the z3 family. It features 14 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 7 physical cores with hyper-threading, delivering 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 112 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core, and includes a bundled 3221 GB local NVMe SSD for high-speed storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates solid processing capabilities, scoring 19217.48 on the Passmark CPU test and 9436.0 on the Geekbench multi-core suite. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated matrix operations, which aids workloads like low-latency inference. For example, the server achieves 1181.08 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M parameter LLM. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 951.78 GB/sec and an uncached large block write bandwidth of 39.89 GB/sec.

The combination of a high-capacity 3221 GB local NVMe SSD and 112 GB of RAM makes this instance highly cost-efficient for data-intensive workloads that require rapid local storage access without the overhead of network-attached storage. It is well-suited for database operations, as evidenced by a Passmark database score of 6737.04 and a Redis SET throughput of 15.53 million operations per second. Other appropriate workloads include static web serving, which reached a throughput of 20.9 GB/sec, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
